turns.text: Get my newest note and close it.

turns.rephrase: I mean: get my latest email.
I mean: change its recipient to Rita.

turns.gold:
PROCEDURE retarget_last_email(person:PERSON)
$v0 = FIND_LAST EMAIL
UPDATE $v0 RECIPIENT={person}
RETURN $v0
END
turns.name: retarget_last_email

turns.text: REQUEST retarget the last email to Judy
